input_policy: Original synthetic documents only in this experiment; no confidential or privileged information
buyer: Ontario-qualified in-house commercial counsel at a B2B software company receiving recurring counterparty NDA revisions
workload_status: Research workload; buyer and monthly recurrence are commercial hypotheses
offering: Source-linked NDA change-control and explicit playbook-support packet
deliverable: original and revised text with hashes
decision_enabled: Counsel can locate changed duties, prioritize departures from an approved organizational playbook and decide which edits or negotiations require legal judgment
professional_boundary: The experiment cannot accept a contract, recommend execution, determine enforceability, provide client legal advice or substitute for qualified professional review
playbook_status: Authored research policy; not approved by counsel and not a statement of Ontario law

rules.policy: Use of confidential information is expressly restricted to evaluating the stated business relationship; broad competitive or other use is a deviation.

An explicit general confidentiality duration of 12 to 36 months inclusive; separate trade-secret survival is escalated rather than interpreted. An indefinite general duty is a deviation; unresolved or conflicting duration is uncertain.

Return or destruction within an explicit 1 to 30 calendar-day period after request. Business days, unreasonable effort qualifiers, missing triggers, and unresolved deadlines are uncertain. More than 30 days is a deviation.
Compelled-disclosure provision requires prior notice when legally permitted. Express no-notice discretion is a deviation. A generic disclosure permission without notice is a deviation.
Express permission to use unaided-memory residual information is a deviation; express prohibition or no residuals clause passes this policy. Ambiguous residuals treatment is uncertain.
Assignment requires the other party's prior written consent. Unrestricted assignment or an express consent exception is a deviation; incomplete/unclear consent is uncertain.
An express Ontario governing-law clause; different or conflicting governing law is respectively deviation or uncertain. No legal opinion about enforceability or choice of law is made.

Disclosure to representatives is restricted to a need-to-know purpose and the recipient remains responsible for their breaches. An explicit disclaimer of responsibility is a deviation; incomplete responsibility wording is uncertain.

scope_exclusions: OCR or binary Office format fidelity
proposal_policy: No free-form legal drafting. Only proposed restoration of a previously supplied clause, clearly conditional on counsel approval, may be offered; otherwise emit a review question. No generated clause is automatically applied.

acceptance.engineering: exact source spans and hashes; exact changed-text coverage; declared in-scope statuses checked against independently authored synthetic keys; zero false pass on severity-5 issue; unresolved items visible
acceptance.professional: NOT_ASSESSED; qualified independent legal review unavailable
acceptance.commercial: NOT_ESTABLISHED until complete delivery including review, matched alternatives and costs is supported

stop_rules: No outcome-dependent primary source fixes or favorable case replacement
Preserve rejected output and investigate only in a new declared cohort
Do not remove professional review or invent observed customer demand
No second investment qualifies from assumed productivity alone

output_schema.source_hashes: object keyed by original, revised, amendment:<id>
output_schema.changes: array with original_span/revised_span; null permitted for insertion/deletion

source_offsets: Python Unicode code-point offsets; end-exclusive; exact original strings; no normalization before quotation

arms.A: Competent human-only complete workflow, not executed; sourced wage data and explicitly assumed task minutes
arms.B: Newly constructed ordinary Python regex/diff adapter in unchanged AGI ALPHA Workbench; not a historical NDA baseline
arms.C: Same adapter plus retained definition/reference and amendment assets
arms.D: Independently authored conventional implementation with equivalent problem specification; commercial Word/Spellbook workflows documented but not executed

transfer: Independent D author gets scope and development inputs but no C source; before and after optional acquired skill on fresh cases, with reconstruction effort retained. General capability absence cannot be inferred from a missing file.
registry_graph: Same inventory, validation evidence and dependencies; fixture-only authority cannot pass live authenticated admission
